nodes.name: Theorem B: $Thm \$
nodes.statement:
Let $\mathfrak{B}$ be a primitive collection of ideals in~$\mathcal{O}_K$. The following are equivalent:
\begin{enumerate}[(i)]
\item $(X_\eta,(S_g)_{g\in\mathcal{O}_K})$ is minimal,
\item $\eta$ is an $\mathcal{O}_K$-Toeplitz array different from $\mathbf{0}$, where $\mathbf{0}_g=0$ for any $g\in\mathcal{O}_K$,
\item $\mathfrak{D}=\emptyset$,
\item $X_\eta\subseteq Y$, where $Y=\{x\in\{0,1\}^{\mathcal{O}_K};\ |\operatorname{supp }x \bmod \mathfrak{b}|=N(\mathfrak{b})-1\text{ for any }\mathfrak{b}\in\mathfrak{B}\}$ ($N(\mathfrak{b})$ stands for the cardinality of the quotient $\mathcal{O}_K/\mathfrak{b}$).
\end{enumerate}

nodes.name: Proposition D: $Prop \$
Theorem E: $Thm \$
nodes.statement: Let $\mathfrak{B}$ be a primitive collection of ideals in~$\mathcal{O}_K$. Suppose $\mathfrak{S}_1\subset \mathfrak{S}_2\subset\dots\nearrow\mathfrak{B}$ is a saturated filtration of $\mathfrak{B}$ by finite collections of ideals in $\mathcal{O}_K$. Assume that $\eta$ is an $\mathcal{O}_K$-Toeplitz array. Then $(\bigcap_{\mathfrak{b}\in\mathfrak{S}_i}\mathfrak{b})_{i\geq1}$ is a periodic structure of $\eta$.

nodes.name: Theorem C: $Thm \$
nodes.statement:
Let $\mathfrak{B}$ be primitive. Then the following are equivalent:
\begin{enumerate}[(i)]
\item $\mathfrak{B}=\mathfrak{B}^*$,
\item $\mathfrak{D}=\emptyset$,
\item $\eta$ is a Toeplitz sequence different from $\bf{0}$.
\end{enumerate}
Moreover, we have
\[
\mathfrak{D}^*:=\{\mathfrak{d} :  \mathfrak{d}\mathcal{C}\subset\mathfrak{B}^* \text{ for some infinite pairwise coprime set }\mathcal{C}\}=\emptyset,
\]
i.e.\ $\mathfrak{B}^*=(\mathfrak{B}^*)^*$ and $\eta^*$ is Toeplitz.

nodes.name: Theorem A: $Thm \$
nodes.statement: Let $\mathfrak{B}$ be a primitive collection of ideals in $\mathcal{O}_K$. Then $\eta^*$ is an $\mathcal{O}_K$-Toeplitz array and $X_{\eta^*}$ is a unique minimal subset of~$X_\eta$. Moreover, $\eta^*\leq\eta$.
